label: PUBLIC_DATA_FINAL_P4
license: CC BY-SA 4.0 stricter recorded attribution terms; ERA5-Land catchment P/T; measured qobs only

spec.formula: train twelve independent Q month means + jointly Ridge P/T [and actual calendar L1] anomalies
spec.inner: training-only year LOYO; one-SE largest alpha; unchanged P2 code
spec.missing: reject missing/no zero imputation; monthly ddof1 std, P2 constant rule

prior_experiments.selection: initial3 ID order; P1 added6 metadata; P2 added18 quality/area/snow/network metadata; P3 same27 no score exclusions
prior_experiments.QC_changes: none; finite nonnegative full-month ckhs1, qceq/qcol diagnostics retained

test_metadata_admissibility: No numeric Q parse in T0; present sentinel + full distinct dates + ckhs1 = provisional source-admissible. Postcommit numerical audit must confirm finite/nonnegative; any mismatch recorded and scoring aborted, no reselection.

direction.positive_mean_and_years_groups: >0 mean station skill AND >=2/3 years AND >=2/3 represented macro groups positive => DIRECTION_SUPPORTED
direction.default: SUPPORTED=>L1; INCONCLUSIVE=>C0+PT default/L1 candidate; NOT_SUPPORTED=>C0+PT default/L1 research candidate; all require valid calibration and no constant departure

pseudo.primary_blocks: four nonoverlapping full-calendar-year accepted blocks at 20/40/60/80 percentiles of available whole years, rounded to nearest index; unique; metadata/calendar selection only
pseudo.other_lengths: one first valid contiguous block at >=1989-01 per length, not required disjoint with primary; only primary12 residuals used calibration
pseudo.refit: each block excludes all held Q, refits alpha and all transforms

interval.type: symmetric empirical primary12 block-out absolute residual, basin-season
interval.scale: season OOF RMSE; normalized absolute residual finite order statistic ceil((n+1)*coverage); if rank>n => UNDEFINED_QUANTILE
interval.kappa: max(1, P3 forward season RMSE / current block-out season RMSE) perbasin/model/season; no finite P3 n>=8 => NO_TRANSFER_SUPPORT (no interval), zero scale => ZERO_RESIDUAL_SCALE
interval.V2: regenerate blocks and transforms with <=2017; retain same kappa rule using old P3 residuals, no fresh independent V2 test

risk.IN_SUPPORT: maxabsz<=3 AND leverage_ratio<=1 AND no constant departure
risk.EXTRAPOLATION_CAUTION: maxabsz<=5 AND leverage_ratio<=2 AND no constant departure
risk.HIGH_EXTRAPOLATION: otherwise; research inference only, not default application eligible
risk.leverage: z'(Z'Z+alphaI)^-1 z divided by train 99th percentile; train Z only

application: true gaps only inside source coverage all daily Q missing sentinel; partial or ckhs0 never true gap; no simulations as labels

demo.model: separate V2 crossfit excluding all2016 Q; V1 calibration only (no2016 labels in interval calibration)

test_prediction_commit: all predictions/intervals and model hashes sealed before first numeric testQ read
claim: retrospective with observed current meteorology, not advance forecast or zero-target transfer
Claude_review: No separately named Claude P4 review found in public workspace; supplied P4-FINAL corrections treated as governing review constraints
